snippet.title: Habet | Official Gameplay Trailer | Gladiator School Game on Steam
snippet.description:
Habet is a gladiator school game coming to Steam. Wishlist it here:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/5333990/Habet/

Run a gladiator school in Pompeii, 73 BC. Buy, train and equip your men, then watch them fight or take control yourself. Keep the survivors fed, tend their wounds, and decide who is sold, buried or freed as war changes the world beyond your gate.

Coming to Steam on Windows, Linux and macOS. Release date to be announced.

Website: https://playhabet.com
Press kit: https://playhabet.com/press

#Habet #gladiator #indiegame #strategygame #ancientrome #steam
